Name: hex's Marlon Edit - Longer Hair and More for SVE - Seasonal Cute Characters
Author: hexadecimal0101
Description:
Edits Marlon's Sprite from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]﻿ to give him longer hair, a more prominent/aquiline nose, and a scar across his nose, alongside an edit of his eyes to make him look at the viewer (and look more like he's compensating for his missing eye!)

This is not a content patcher mod; it ONLY contains the edited portraits. This was meant to work alongside and match the vanilla+ aesthetic of Seasonal Cute Outfits and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿. Big appreciation to Poltergeister, Ailin and Tanpoponoko for allowing edits of their beautiful spritework!

Feel free to make further edits, compatibility with other mods (like Make Marlon Real) or anything of the sort! Just please remember to credit the original Seasonal Cute Outfits creators!

To install:
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE
[/url]2. Unzip the zip file provided in the downloads
3. Replace the Marlon and MarlonFay folders with the folders inside the zip
